analyses.text: Before freeze, map M1A effect_observation_record to M1C EffectIntent/EffectTraceInput without dropping effect ID/key, packet/goal/plan digests, attempt identity, idempotency key, lease/fence/admission/pause epochs or ambiguity. Define lease_epoch, writer_fence_epoch, process/daemon epoch and admission/pause epoch as distinct namespaces with an identified consumer. Hash chaining does not authenticate a writer; M1C fabric-only readiness is not OR-015. Model current-immediate as the only operative PAUSE policy; future data values cannot grant transitions. Represent partition, provider non-response, partial process termination and reconnect as environment inputs. Either include bounded broker cursor/credit state or state a separate proof obligation: detected gap requires RESET before any EVENT, slow views cannot block canonical append. Preserve E-FHAR2-101 finite bound: one aggregate/task/effect/timer/verifier, two workers/goal epochs/plan revisions/attempts, three lease epochs, at most twenty events and bounded queues. Keep TypeOK, chain/atomic append, idempotence, attenuation, lease/amendment/PAUSE/retry/cancel/effect/verifier safety, replay/fail-closed/projection parity, flow bound and no blind replay. Safety is unconditional within the modeled environment; liveness names fairness and recovery assumptions. No guarantee that Owner, provider or network eventually responds. Guard-removal mutants must produce minimal counterexamples. Mapping is a model adapter proposal, not a repair to immutable M1 schemas.

For every actual request j, partition billed prompt tokens into U_j uncached non-write, H_j cache-read, W_j cache-write classes (tokens); O_j is billed output including billable reasoning. Reconcile vendor fields first: input totals may already include cache tokens. C_API = sum_j[(U_j*pU_j + H_j*pH_j + W_j*pW_j + O_j*pO_j)/1,000,000 + tool_fee_j] + sum_k[S_k*pS_k], in USD. pU/pH/pW/pO are USD per million tokens and include full-request threshold/tier multipliers. S is million-token-hours and pS is USD per million-token-hour; explicit-cache storage is zero only when that route charges none. Every refresh, compaction, retry and reviewer model request is one j, never an extra surcharge after already counting it. Report host CPU/RAM/disk, wall time, human review minutes and quality/failure vector separately; monetize only with explicitly approved weights. API USD, subscription-debit observations and inferred capacity are distinct quantities; absent counters are null. For an idle gap with n refreshes, expected savings = expected no-refresh future cost minus (sum refresh request costs + expected future cost after refresh + incremental storage). Refresh is useful only if positive at equal quality/latency requirements. With no future work it cannot save request cost; with miss probability zero it has no avoided-miss benefit. Evaluate eviction, TTL boundaries, prefix changes and provider/account scope. Do not confuse TTL renewal with semantic memory preservation. Stable complete schemas/order/serialization help prefix matching; repeated tool names alone do not. Never retain stale results to optimize a cache statistic.

API snapshots on 2026-09-05: Astra context capacity 1,050,000 tokens; standard per-million input/read/write/output USD 10/1/12.5/50. More than 272K input tokens applies 2x input/cache and 1.5x output to the full request. These are not subscription debit rules. OpenAI GPT-5.6+ documents a 30-minute minimum cache lifetime after write/reuse, potentially longer retention; earlier models differ. Anthropic documents 5-minute and 1-hour retention, renewed by reuse with request-start timing, write factors 1.25 and 2, and model-dependent reads (0.1 normally; 0.025 for listed Fable/Mythos 5.1 exceptions). Gemini separates implicit matching and explicit TTL/storage. Minimum snapshots: OpenAI GPT-5.6+ requires 1,024 visible input tokens (older models generally 2,048); Anthropic Opus 4.7 requires 2,048, listed Fable/Mythos 5.1 and Opus 5 require 512; Gemini 3.8 Flash requires 4,096, Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro 2,048. Revalidate exact model/platform before trials. Gemini Interactions supports implicit caching only and reports usage.total_cached_tokens; generateContent also supports explicit cache objects with default one-hour TTL and storage cost, with usage_metadata. Normalize these endpoint-specific fields in later probes. Native Codex compaction can be threshold-triggered; do not assume only milestone triggers. Claims of Codex drift, Claude compaction quality or Hermes inefficiency remain anecdotes without matched trials.

Expose only what a route actually returns: explicit reasoning text, permitted reasoning summaries, opaque/encrypted continuation state, token counts or ordinary action explanations. These are separate types with provenance and visibility limits. No request to reconstruct hidden chain of thought. Canonical decisions must cite observable evidence, not unverifiable private reasoning. An opaque native session can accelerate continuation but cannot be required for Recursion authority recovery.

Developer/power user: first success is a bounded repository change with inspectable plan/diff/gate and successful interruption/recovery; expects route/tool control, understands repositories, tolerates explicit setup; measure accepted tasks and review minutes. Casual user: first success is a narrow guided task with clear permission/cost preview and one recoverable failure; should not need model/config terminology; measure unassisted completion, comprehension and support requests. Organization-operated instance: first success is an auditable scoped task under identity/role and secret boundaries; administrators own setup, revocation, export and updates; measure policy failures and operational support cost. Hosted multi-tenant service adds isolated authority/data/account domains, residency, private networking, procurement and incident obligations. These are prospective jobs/requirements, not observed demand or compliance. Lucas-first remains accepted; developer external cohort is a proposal. One product with optional profiles avoids inventing a commercial tier policy.

Ranked adaptations: (1) replay-certified adapters catch upstream drift, medium maintenance cost, removable with engine; falsifier is an undetected semantic mutation. (2) capability-scoped command bridges preserve CLI familiarity, medium translation cost, removable mappings; falsifier is grant or argument expansion. (3) evidence-carrying handoffs preserve source/goal/lease identities, low-to-medium artifact/review cost, replaceable format; falsifier is a stale accepted packet. (4) compaction fidelity budgets may reduce recovery errors, extra compactor/review cost, opt-out to baseline; falsifier is directive loss or no net gain. (5) review-aware routing may improve accepted work per total budget, substantial evaluation cost, removable policy; falsifier is baseline dominance. Protocol negotiation, supply-chain checks, provenance and controlled agent evaluation are prior art. Their Recursion combination is an adaptation; no claim of first invention or industry leadership.
